newsitem.title: USA: First Colorado sets 2nd buyback of shares.
newsitem.headline: First Colorado sets 2nd buyback of shares.

text.p: First Colorado Bancorp Inc. said on Monday the Office of Thrift Supervision had approved a second stock repurchase program providing for the buyback of up to five percent of its 19.13 million outstanding shares of common stock.
The company said in a statement shares may be purchased in the open market until December 31, subject to availability, market conditions, trading price and the company's financial performance.

Repurchased shares will be held as treasury shares and will be utilized for general corporate purposes, including the issuances of shares in connection with the exercise of stock options awarded under the company's stock benefit plans.
On August 9, the company completed the repurchase of an initial five percent of its outstanding shares in the open market.
